senses.gloss: 1. अम् ind. quickly, a little, (g. चादि, q.v.)
2. अम् the termination अम् in the comparative and other forms used as ind., e.g. प्रतर॑म्, &c., (g. स्वर्-आदि, q.v.)
आ॑म् ind. an interjection of assent or recollection, MaitrS.; Mṛcch.; Śak.; Vikr. &c.
(a vocative following this particle is anudātta, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 55.)
